name: The Tailor's Measure
summary: A thread from a companion's past, picked up by someone in Wickermoor.

stages.journal: The Tailor's Measure: something on the train left a thread loose, and it picks up in Wickermoor.
stages.hint: Reach Wickermoor Village and be welcomed.

waits.text: Thomasin Ardor in Wickermoor will pick this up once the village has welcomed us.

stages.journal: Thomasin took Cordelia's measure, and neither of them said what the fitting was really for.
